rules.name: xoga713-legacy-var-view-definitions-all
rules.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME AS view_name, CHAR_LENGTH(VIEW_DEFINITION) AS definition_length, VIEW_DEFINITION AS definition FROM information_schema.VIEWS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbsystemuat' AND TABLE_NAME REGEXP '^helper_var_(future_view|vanilla_view|accounting_report)_[a-z0-9]{2,4}$' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

SELECT upper(business_unit) AS business_unit, derivative_type AS derivative_type_exact, count(*) AS row_count, min(value_date) AS first_date, max(value_date) AS last_date FROM opera.var_accounting_table GROUP BY upper(business_unit), derivative_type ORDER BY 1, 2

expect.reason: three views for each of the 33 business units
